verdict.instructions: Which triage verdict best fits the task using the supplied evidence? Judge the reported problem, not the task writing style.

criteria.VALID: Actionable work remains relevant and is not shown resolved.
criteria.FIXED: An implementation or completed operational action resolves the requested work.
criteria.OBSOLETE: The requested work is no longer relevant because the old feature, premise or workflow was removed or replaced.
criteria.DUPLICATE: A supplied other task describes the same work and can carry it.
criteria.UNCLEAR: The record does not establish a sufficiently concrete issue or present status.

area.instructions: Which subsystem owns the primary requested change? Prefer the underlying component over incidental mentions of tests or review.

criteria.hub-web: Commander/hub-web frontend UI, browser journeys and accessibility
criteria.cloud: Cloud identity, cloud sync and remote stores
criteria.ci: CI workflows, runner infrastructure, build caches and test execution infrastructure
criteria.release: Release train, install/update and publication procedures
criteria.qa: QA verdicts, visual-QA checker, evidence bundles and review rounds
criteria.factory: Factory daemon, worker lifecycle, spawning, coordination and terminal sessions
criteria.close-gate: Task close, delivery ancestry, merge verification and receipt gates
criteria.hooks: Harness hooks, permissions, workspace enforcement and initialization
criteria.memory-search: Memory, knowledge, retrieval and search quality
criteria.slack: Violet Slack transport and Slack publication policy
criteria.other: Other area or area cannot be determined

severity.instructions: Rate impact of the described problem if it still occurs. Judge impact, not whether it is fixed.
criteria: Cosmetic or optional cleanup; no material workflow failure.
Small usability or maintenance issue with a straightforward workaround.
Blocks a normal workflow or causes repeatable incorrect behavior for some users.
Broad outage, lost data, credential exposure or isolation/authority breach.

candidate_resolves.instructions: Does the candidate commit implement the change requested by task? Use its subject and patch as evidence.

criteria.true: The candidate change directly resolves the reported failure or completes the requested work.
criteria.false: It only shares a topic, is partial, is unrelated, or does not show a resolution.
